seed.mechanism: Stock cloud-init NoCloud; configuration data placed in a disposable root partition copy with native debugfs
seed.authentication: Temporary Ed25519 public key; ssh_pwauth false; disable_root true; guest generates its own Ed25519 host key
seed.verification: Seed user-data read back byte-for-byte before writing the partition into the disposable raw disk

first_boot.network: eth0 UP at 10.0.2.15/24 through canonical agentOS virtio-net; QEMU user backend restrict=on with only loopback 127.0.0.1:12224 forwarded to guest port 22
first_boot.ssh_proof: Authenticated using publickey; uname -m returned x86_64; exit status 0
first_boot.host_key_verification: SSH peer fingerprint matched the guest console's generated host-key fingerprint
first_boot.negative_authentication: An unrelated Ed25519 key was rejected with Permission denied (publickey), exit 255; SSH agent and other identity sources disabled
first_boot.cloud_init: 25.1.4; status done; DataSourceNoCloud from the seed directory; errors [] and recoverable_errors {}
first_boot.shutdown: sudo sync succeeded over SSH before owned QEMU was stopped through QMP quit

cold_boot.disk: Same boot-19.raw disk, without reseeding; new QEMU process after first-boot sync and shutdown
cold_boot.ssh_proof: Strict host-key checking matched the original Ed25519 host key; original public key authenticated; uname -m returned x86_64; exit status 0
cold_boot.cloud_init: status done; DataSourceNoCloud from the same seed directory; errors [] and recoverable_errors {}
cold_boot.shutdown: sudo sync succeeded over SSH before QMP quit; no test QEMU process remains
cold_boot.verification: Retained local log hashes match the Intel host copies; root-task ELF hash remains unchanged

limitations: Manual diagnostic media preparation and QEMU launch; native seed builder and SSH gate integration are not implemented yet
First readiness probes reset or timed out during startup; the successful SSH proof used a bounded 90-second attempt
No throughput, latency, GUI, concurrent guest isolation or release qualification is claimed
Private login and host keys are not included in this receipt or repository
